definitions.short: Beth-Peor , a place East of the Jordan
definitions.full: H1047. Beth Peor מְּעוֺר בֵּית proper name, of a location (= ׳בּ פ ׳בַּעַל , compare below בעל ) east of Jordan Deut 3:29 , in land of Amorites 4:46 compare Josh 13:20 (where assigned to Reuben); in land of Moab Deut 34:6 . On site compare Di Num 23:28 Lag Onom. 232. 2nd ed. 246 Cond Heth & Moab 142 f. PEF 1882, 85 f. Tristr Moab 305 .
